scope: 18 fresh-VM actual-runtime constructed trials: three equal-spend scoring packages, three actual launch policies, two seeds. Package policies deliberately use early return, stay aloft or approach entry targets. No natural acquisition or population win-rate claim. Conditional score additions reflect observed bank facts; damage/encounter RNG can diverge after policy changes. Low/mid/high labels are intended launch angles, with actual angles recorded.

setup.kind: Constructed initial previous-run level/stats and custom wave9 shop offers at actual real prices, then actual commands buy/combine/next. No in-fight grants, forced kills, or refills.
